name: Unnamed Cargo Pants (Patched)
description: No-brand cargo pants that have been repaired so many times the original fabric is almost a minority. Patches in denim, synth-canvas, and heat-fused mylar strips cover the knees, seat, and inner thighs. The pockets still work — all six of them — which is the only thing that matters on the Shelf.
what_it_says: You've been surviving longer than most. These pants have a history and so do you.
story_hooks: A hidden inner pocket contains a folded note in a language the current owner doesn't read.
The patch on the left knee is cut from a Tier 4 corporate uniform — someone's past is stitched in.
